_note: German AOK 10 order of battle 9 Sep-31 Dec 1943 for the grand campaign. Compiled from Molony vol. V and Blumenson (archive.org full text), CMH 100-8 and Wikipedia. Coordinates from Wikipedia town articles unless coordSource says otherwise. suggestedValues for NEW counters are by analogy with existing Salerno 43 / Italy 43 counters, not from any rulebook. Units marked "uncertain" say why. type "formation" entries track a whole division where battalion detail is lacking.

sources.CMH 100-8: From the Volturno to the Winter Line (CMH Pub 100-8), https://archive.org/details/TheVolturnoToTheWinterLine

events.event: Landings at Salerno; 16 Pz Div in four battle groups 3-6 miles inland (Doernemann, Stempel, von Holtey, von Doering).
LXXVI Pz Corps takes control south of Mt Giovi-Giffoni from noon; 14 Pz Corps north of it.
Main German counter-attack against the gap between the Allied corps (Sele-Calore).
Last attacks (26 Pz, Schmalz); von Vietinghoff proposes breaking off; Kesselring agrees 17 Sep.
29 PG begins to disengage; 26 Pz follows c.19 Sep; withdrawal orders 18 Sep.
1 FJ Div takes positions W and N of Foggia; Foggia occupied by 8th Army.
Naples entered; Germans keep no troops S of Naples after night 30 Sep/1 Oct.
Kesselring orders 16 Pz Div from 14 Pz Corps to Campobasso (parts ordered east evening 1 Oct); Blumenson has the move starting morning 4 Oct.
events.why: sources differ on start of move

events.event: Termoli landing; KG Rau scattered; 16 Pz counter-attacks 4-6 Oct; Herr sanctions withdrawal 6 Oct 16:35. 16 Pz casualties 573.
Hitler directive: delaying only as far as Gaeta-Ortona line, which is to be held.
von Vietinghoff sanctions 76 Pz Corps withdrawal to its Barbara line portion; 65 ID trains bombed near Pescara.
events.source: Molony V p.457; Molony V p.465

events.event: Fifth Army crosses the Volturno; 14 Pz Corps step-by-step withdrawal 14-24 Oct to Raviscanina-Mondragone.
von Senger replaces Hube at 14 Pz Corps.
Trigno: S. Salvo lost; Sieckenius begins withdrawal to the Advanced Sangro line via Scerni/Atessa.
Lemelsen takes over AOK 10 (to 28 Dec).
Most of 26 Pz Div in 14 Pz Corps sector (9 PG from 6 Nov).
29 PG ordered from S of Rome to 14 Pz Corps to relieve 3 PG.
16 Pz and 3 PG withdrawal begins (c.); Clark pauses the offensive.
events.source: Molony V p.454; Molony V p.477-478

events.event: Kesselring takes over OB Suedwest / Army Group C; orders 90 PG to the Adriatic.
26 Pz returns to 76 Pz Corps.
Sangro: Mozzagrogna; von Ziehlberg (65 ID) wounded; 29 Nov S. Maria lost; 30 Nov Fossacesia lost; 145 Gren Regt written off.
Second Camino battle 1-9 Dec; 15 PG authorised to withdraw 8 Dec.
90 PG relief of 65 ID almost complete; 65 ID to narrow sector behind Casoli-Orsogna.
Decision to move whole 1 FJ Div to coastal sector; Korpsgruppe Hauck formed between the corps.
AOK 10 sanctions step-by-step withdrawal to the Foro line; 14 Pz Corps abandons Bernhardt sector of 44 ID/29 PG.
events.source: Molony V p.503; Molony V p.520

events.event: 334 ID begins to arrive (c.); 5 Mountain Div c.17 Dec.
Ortona street fighting begins (to 28 Dec), defended by II/3, III/3 and II/4 FJ.
Lemelsen approves withdrawal from Ortona; Tesoro stream line.
AOK 10 casualties in December 13,362; 76 Pz Corps 2,051 on 1-10 Dec.

losses.value: 840 killed, 2,002 wounded, 630 missing (3,472); 70 tanks, 21 assault guns lost
573 casualties (126 casualties + 108 sick in first two days)
over 3,500 incl. 914 sick; divisions averaged c.2,100 front-line infantry

strengths.value: 16 Pz: 6 Pz IV, 5 cmd, 9 StuG. 26 Pz: 28 Pz III, 42 Pz IV, 8 cmd, 12 flame, 21 StuG
